status_note: Reproduces on 12.0.0 with pandas 3.1.1; Ibis main (6d40f963, 2026-11-05) still reads the option in `ibis/formats/pandas.py` (lines 38 and 60). No upstream issue found.
title: Every `execute()` warns: Ibis reads pandas's deprecated `future.infer_string`
summary: Ibis reads the deprecated `pd.options.future.infer_string` in `PandasType.from_ibis` (`ibis/formats/pandas.py:60`), so every `execute()` warns `Pandas4Warning: The 'future.infer_string' option is deprecated` under pandas 3.1, also for a scalar with no string in it.
handling: The checks on data fetch their counts through Arrow (`_count` in `conditions.py`: `to_pyarrow().as_py()`), so users see no warning ([#479](https://github.com/AlexanderNenninger/substrait-lean/issues/479)). The tests still ignore the message (`filterwarnings` in `python/pyproject.toml`).

checked.note: triage: repro run on 12.0.0; main read; ibis-project/ibis searched
